versions.changelog:
Improve discovery-style triggering, add no-match fallbacks, and expand natural-language queries for better skill finding.

增强口语化触发词，补充无结果兜底逻辑，并优化“找 skill”场景下的发现体验。

Add explicit clawhub CLI dependency metadata and improve provenance details.

补充 clawhub CLI 依赖声明，并增强来源说明。

Initial release: trending rankings, must-have rankings, and topic-based skill discovery with ClawHub links, install-state labeling, and pre-install vetting.

首次发布：支持趋势榜、装机必备榜、主题热门榜，支持 ClawHub 链接补全、已安装标注和先审后装。
